description: Forget a note by id: it is archived, so it no longer appears in search, lists or recall. It is NOT erased: a person can bring it back with `monomem restore <id>` or the dashboard, and only a person can delete it permanently (dashboard or `monomem delete <id>`). Tell the user this when they ask you to forget something sensitive.

id.description: Id of the note to delete.

name: state_delete
title: Forget a note (archive)
